detail.longDescription: Google found a way to test Gemini without seeing the questions Google DeepMind launches double-blind AI evaluation for Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite—hiding both model weights and test questions to prevent benchmark leakage that inflates scores. Using Google Cloud Confidential Space with advanced encryption, the pilot emphasizes evaluation integrity over numbers. Future scaling could revolutionize transparent AI testing beyond benchmarks. 🔐 https:// thenewstack.io/google-double-b lind-evaluation/ # AI # MachineLearning
